newsitem.title: USA: America West should meet Q4 EPS estimates.
newsitem.headline: America West should meet Q4 EPS estimates.

text.p: America West Airlines Inc said Friday it should meet fourth quarter earnings estimates of $0.20 to $0.22 per share.
"We should meet our earnings objectives for the fourth quarter and we look for 1997 to be another good year for the industry and America West," the company stated.
On Friday the company posted a third quarter loss of $1.03 per share that included a $65 million charge. Year-ago earnings were a profit of $0.46.

The company said it is optimistic about current cost and revenue trends. It said it recently approved a fuel hedging program and expects to continue double-digit growth in available seat miles next year, when it will have added eight new aircraft and six cities to its routes.
